summary: 教学研究的重点逐步从学生背景和教师特征转向课堂上实际发生的互动。文章追踪课堂观察方法的发展，以及不同教学风格怎样成为可比较的研究对象。
logic: 早期寻找学习成绩的预测因素
传统课堂与儿童中心教育
观察不同风格下的师生互动
研究转向真实课堂过程

paragraphs.brief: 对教师的研究主要是寻求有效性的标准，许多调查寻求个性或态度与教学中的 " 成功 " 之间的联系。
sentences: Prior to 1960, most inquiries into pupils’ learning skills explored the relationship between factors such as children’s social background, personality or measured intelligence and their achievement in various school subjects.
1960年以前，大多数关于学生学习技能的调查探讨了儿童的社会背景、个性或有分寸的智力等因素与他们在各种学校科目上的成绩之间的关系。
Studies of teachers were largely a quest for criteria of effectiveness, and numerous investigations sought links between personality or attitude and ‘success’ at teaching.
对教师的研究主要是寻求有效性的标准，许多调查寻求个性或态度与教学中的 " 成功 " 之间的联系。
By 1950, Domas and Tiedeman were able to survey 672 such studies of teacher effectiveness.
到1950年，Domas和Tiedeman得以对672项关于教师效能的研究进行了调查。
Yet there was widespread disappointment with such research, partly because so little of value seemed to emerge.
然而，对这种研究普遍感到失望，部分原因是似乎没有多少价值。
First of all, there was little agreement about what constituted ‘good’ teaching or who the good teachers were.
首先，对于什么是`好 ' 教学或谁是好老师，意见很少一致。
Secondly, there were numerous conflicting and contradictory findings.
第二，有许多相互矛盾和相互矛盾的结论。
No sooner had one investigator found a relationship which appeared to be significant, than another discovered the opposite effect.
一名调查员发现一种似乎很重要的关系，而另一名调查员发现相反的影响。

paragraphs.brief: 然而，Rolfe发现，智力与教学效率之间没有关联：他声称，教师的个性是产生良好教学成果的原因。
sentences: For example, in 1945, two American researchers, Rostker and Rolfe, both using standardized testing techniques and broad samples of teachers, reached exactly opposite conclusions.
例如，1945年，两名美国研究人员Rostker和Rolfe使用标准化测试技术和教师的样本，得出了完全相反的结论。

Rostker concluded that the intelligence of the teacher is the most important single factor conditioning teaching ability, and that there is no significant relationship between personality and teaching ability.
Rostker的结论是，教师的智力是制约教学能力的最重要的一个因素，人格与教学能力之间没有重大的关系。
Rolfe, however, found no correlation between intelligence and teaching efficiency: he claimed that the teacher’s personality was what produced good teaching.
然而，Rolfe发现，智力与教学效率之间没有关联：他声称，教师的个性是产生良好教学成果的原因。

Another American writer, Barr (1961), summarized a massive amount of American research and underlined the chaos in the research literature on effectiveness: “Some teachers were preferred by administrators, some were liked by the pupils, and some taught in classes where there were substantial pupil gains, and generally speaking these were not the same teachers.”
另一位美国作家巴尔(巴尔(巴尔，1961年)总结了美国的大量研究，并强调了关于有效性的研究文献中的混乱状况：“一些教师被行政管理者所偏爱，有些被学生所喜爱，有些在学生获得大量收益的班级中教授，一般说来，他们不是同一批教师。”

paragraphs.brief: 最早的研究之一始于1912年，当时史蒂文斯对各学科领域的课程进行了100次随机观察，以便分析教师所提问题的数量和性质。
sentences: One of the earliest pieces of research dates from 1912, when Stevens made 100 random observations of lessons in a variety of subject areas, in order to analyze the number and nature of questions being asked by teachers.
最早的研究之一始于1912年，当时史蒂文斯对各学科领域的课程进行了100次随机观察，以便分析教师所提问题的数量和性质。
Stevens’s overall total was 64% teacher talk and 36% pupil talk, figures which are remarkably similar to a number of findings half a century later.
史蒂文斯的总人数是64%的教师和36%的学生，这些数字与半个世纪后的一些研究结果非常相似。

paragraphs.brief: 这种研究通常以观察在职教师为基础，1920年代和1930年代，美国行政人员也广泛采用这一技术，以评估教师的能力，向所谓的 " 优等 " 教师分配功绩报酬。
sentences: For many years in the first half of the 20th century, so-called ‘formal’ teaching was the norm.
20世纪前半叶，所谓的“正式”教学是常态。

Teachers taught their classes as a whole group, gave out information, asked questions which predominantly required factual recall, and frequently set a common written task for the children to complete in a prescribed period of time.
教师们作为一个整体教授他们的班级，提供信息，提出主要需要实际回忆的问题，并经常为儿童在规定时间内完成共同的书面任务。
It was hardly surprising, therefore, that one focus of classroom interaction research in the decades following Stevens’s inquiry was on the phenomenon of ‘attentiveness’.
因此，在史蒂文斯调查之后的几十年里，课堂互动研究的一个重点是`注意 ' 现象，这并不奇怪。

A number of studies in the 1920s and 1930s, by Morrison and others, sought relationships between the degree of attention being paid by children and the amount they subsequently appeared to have learnt.
莫里森和其他人在1920年代和1930年代进行的一些研究寻求将儿童所关注的程度与他们后来似乎学到的金额联系起来。

Such research was usually based on observing teachers at work, a technique which was also employed extensively by United States administrators in the 1920s and 1930s, in order to assess teachers’ competence and allocate merit payments to so-called ‘superior’ teachers.
这种研究通常以观察在职教师为基础，1920年代和1930年代，美国行政人员也广泛采用这一技术，以评估教师的能力，向所谓的 " 优等 " 教师分配功绩报酬。

paragraphs.brief: 以儿童为中心的教育运动正在形成势头，随着对儿童发展的兴趣增加，调查人员开始发现直接观察和儿童行为分类的有用性。
sentences: As the 1930s came to an end, it was partly the emergence of totalitarian regimes in Europe which led to a shift in interest in the United States away from attentiveness, with its emphasis on the authority of the teacher, and towards a scrutiny of authoritarianism itself.
随着1930年代的结束，部分是由于欧洲极权主义政权的出现，导致美国的利益从注重教师权威的关心转向专权主义本身的审视。
A number of people began to feel that if dictatorship were to be avoided, children must learn in school how to handle democracy.
一些人开始感到，如果要避免独裁统治，儿童就必须在学校学习如何对待民主。
Several investigators examined the processes taking place within small discussion groups, and tried to establish superiority for discussion groups over lecture classes, but with conflicting results.
一些调查员审查了在小型讨论小组内进行的进程，并试图确定讨论小组优于讲座，但结果相互矛盾。

The movement towards what was becoming known as child-centred education was gathering momentum, and as interest in child development increased, investigators began to discover the usefulness of direct observation and the categorization of child behavior.
以儿童为中心的教育运动正在形成势头，随着对儿童发展的兴趣增加，调查人员开始发现直接观察和儿童行为分类的有用性。

paragraphs.brief: Anderson试图测量现在通常所说的“教室气候”。
sentences: This was when systematic observation of teacher-pupil interaction began in earnest.
那时，教师与学生之间互动的系统观测开始认真。
Anderson (1939) studied what he called ‘domination’ and ‘integration’ amongst kindergarten children.
Anderson(1939年)研究了他所谓的幼儿园儿童中的 " 征服者 " 和 " 融合 "。

Dominative acts by children included blaming and snatching toys, and such acts by teachers included restricting children’s activities; while children’s integrative acts included sharing facilities and playing harmoniously, and those of teachers included expanding opportunities for self-direction and co-operation.
儿童的主导行为包括责备和抢夺玩具，而教师的这类行为包括限制儿童的活动；而儿童的融合行为包括分享设施和和谐地玩耍，而教师的行为包括扩大自我指导和合作的机会。
Anderson then attempted to measure what is now commonly called ‘classroom climate’.
Anderson试图测量现在通常所说的“教室气候”。

paragraphs.brief: Lewin、Lippitt和White(1939年和1943年)研究了不同教学方式的影响。
sentences: Lewin, Lippitt and White (1939 and 1943) studied the effects of different teaching styles.
Lewin、Lippitt和White(1939年和1943年)研究了不同教学方式的影响。
They arranged for three groups of five boys each to be taught in very different ways: these were labelled ‘authoritarian’, ‘democratic’ and ‘laissez-faire’.
他们安排了三组五个男孩以非常不同的方式接受教育：这些被称为“专制”、“民主”和“laissez-faire”。
The first two of these were similar to Anderson’s concept of dominative and integrative teachers.
前两个概念与安德森的主导和融合教师概念相似。

paragraphs.brief: 从1949年的Withall工作开始，人们对课堂内的互动兴趣更大。
sentences: Beginning with Withall’s work in 1949, there was much greater interest in interaction within the classroom.
从1949年的Withall工作开始，人们对课堂内的互动兴趣更大。

Withall used the term ‘social-emotional climate’ to describe the emotional tone created as a result of face-to-face interaction in groups, and, like many who followed him, concentrated his analysis of this climate on the study of teachers’ verbal behavior.
威尔托尔用"社会情感气候"这个词来描述群体面对面互动造成的情感音调。

Withall also made efforts towards increasing the reliability of analyses, and this important pioneering work in the development of classroom observation methodology was followed by many others during the 1950s.
此外，还努力提高分析的可靠性，许多其他国家在1950年代期间，在制订课堂观测方法方面开展了这项重要的开拓性工作。

paragraphs.brief: 1960-70年的十年中，根据在职教师的观察结果，对教学过程进行了大量研究，其部分原因是教师效率研究的结果令人失望，部分原因在于先前的工作普遍忽视了课堂实际行为的各种变数。
sentences: Partly because of the disappointing results of the teacher-effectiveness research, and partly because of the general neglect in earlier work of the variables of actual classroom behavior, the decade 1960–70 produced a large number of studies of classroom processes, based on observation of teachers at work.
1960-70年的十年中，根据在职教师的观察结果，对教学过程进行了大量研究，其部分原因是教师效率研究的结果令人失望，部分原因在于先前的工作普遍忽视了课堂实际行为的各种变数。

items.en: the influence of political events on research
items.zh: 政治活动对研究的影响
items.why: E 段把美国教学研究兴趣的转变，部分归因于欧洲极权政体兴起，直接建立了政治事件与研究方向的联系。

items.en: an example of how children’s behavior was categorized for research purposes
items.zh: 儿童行为如何被分类用于研究目的的例子
items.why: F 段介绍安德森研究幼儿园儿童时，将所观察的行为归为“支配”和“整合”两类，正是为研究而分类的实例。

items.en: a reason for research into children’s attention
items.zh: 研究儿童关注问题的理由
items.why: 在当时强调整班听讲和记忆的课堂中，学生能否专心是显眼的问题，因此后来研究师生互动的人会把注意力作为研究重点。

items.en: 1920–1939 Research largely investigated the relationship between children’s attentiveness and their ________.
items.zh: 1920至1939年，研究主要考察儿童的专注程度与其 ________ 之间的关系。
items.why: “attention…learnt"= 专注度与学到的东西= learning,语义一一对应。

items.en: In addition, attentiveness was used to measure the ________ of the teachers.

items.en: 1939–49 Research was influenced by a growing distrust of ________.
items.zh: 1939至1949年，人们日益不信任 ________，当时的研究也受到这一趋势的影响。
items.why: “对威权主义的不信任” 来源于极权/独裁的出现,E 段明确指出研究转向对 authoritarianism 的审视。

items.en: The period saw the beginnings of systematic analysis of the ________ which occur in lecture classes and in small group discussions.
items.zh: 这一时期，研究者开始系统分析讲授式课堂和小组讨论中发生的 ________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“一些调查员审查了在小型讨论小组内进行的进程，并试图确定讨论小组优于讲座，但结果相互矛盾”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: 1949–60 Classroom transactions were analysed in more detail, often with a focus on the ________ of teachers.
items.zh: 1949至1960年，对课堂互动的分析更加细致，教师的 ________ 常常是研究重点。
items.why: 回到对应内容“威尔托尔用"社会情感气候"这个词来描述群体面对面互动造成的情感音调”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: Researchers aimed to improve the ________ of their methods.
items.zh: 研究者希望提高其研究方法的 ________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“此外，还努力提高分析的可靠性，许多其他国家在1950年代期间，在制订课堂观测方法方面开展了这项重要的开拓性工作”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.zh: 1960至1970年，以现场 ________ 为基础的研究数量大幅增加。

items.zh: 声称对成功教学最重要的贡献是情报部门

items.zh: 建立实验，以发现学生如何对各类教学作出反应

items.zh: 重点是教师在课堂上提出的问题

items.zh: 发现成功教学与老师的个性之间有联系

clauses: Yet there was widespread disappointment with such research, ….
连接词 because 引出“partly because so little of value seemed to emerge”，说明主句的原因关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 because 把这一层关系补进去。
Rolfe, however, found no correlation between intelligence and teaching efficiency: he claimed ….
“that the teacher’s personality was what produced good teaching”补足 claimed 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 claimed 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
